rules.cwe_name: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting')
rules.description: Functions recursively assigning properties on objects may be the cause of accidental modification of a built-in prototype object.

rules.cwe_name: Improper Control of Resource Identifiers ('Resource Injection')
rules.description: creating arbitrary environment variables from user controlled data is not secure

rules.cwe_name: Improper Neutralization of Argument Delimiters in a Command ('Argument Injection')
rules.description: Building a shell command string with values from the enclosing environment may cause subtle bugs or vulnerabilities.

rules.cwe_name: Improper Control of Generation of Code ('Code Injection')
rules.description: Invoking user-controlled methods on certain objects can lead to remote code execution.

rules.cwe_name: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements used in an LDAP Query ('LDAP Injection')
rules.description: Building a database query from user-controlled sources is vulnerable to insertion of malicious code by the user.

rules.cwe_name: Return Inside Finally Block
rules.description: Avoid using unstructured control flow statements (return, continue, or break) inside a 'finally' block.

rules.cwe_name: Assignment to Variable without Use
rules.description: If an object literal has two properties with the same name, the second property overwrites the first one, which makes the code hard to understand and error-prone.

rules.cwe_name: Deserialization of Untrusted Data
rules.description: Deserializing user-controlled data may allow attackers to execute arbitrary code.

rules.cwe_name: Dead Code
rules.description: An expression that has no effect and is used in a void context is most likely redundant and may indicate a bug.

rules.cwe_name: Improper Restriction of Recursive Entity References in DTDs ('XML Entity Expansion')
rules.description: Parsing user input as an XML document with arbitrary internal entity expansion is vulnerable to denial-of-service attacks.

rules.cwe_name: Data Processing Errors
rules.description: Legacy category for incorrect handling or transformation of structured data.

rules.cwe_name: Exposure of Sensitive Information to an Unauthorized Actor
rules.description: External links that open in a new tab or window but do not specify link type 'noopener' or 'noreferrer' are a potential security risk.

rules.cwe_name: Uncontrolled Resource Consumption
rules.description: Allowing writes to arbitrary properties of an object may lead to denial-of-service attacks.

rules.cwe_name: Inclusion of Web Functionality from an Untrusted Source
rules.description: Including functionality from an untrusted source may allow an attacker to control the functionality and execute arbitrary code.
